description: ReelBolt is an AI video team for anyone with a story to tell and no time to tell it. Drop in the clips you already shot, say what the video is for, and get a reviewed cut you can change.
featureList: AI-scripted video production
Automatic editing of raw footage
Timeline editor with version history
Layered picture and thumbnail editor
AI-designed graphics in your brand colors and fonts
Brand kit and shared brand library
Titles, captions, color grading, music and sound effects
AI narration with consented voice cloning
Dubs and pickups
AI-generated b-roll under a spending cap
Multi-agent editing rooms
Tracked screen inserts
Object tracking and blurring
Automated quality review of every draft
Chat assistant with approval cards, also in Claude Code
Sync from GitHub, computer folders and cloud drives
Bring your own AI provider and choose models per agent
Rendering on a paired machine you own
Output resolution and format chosen per run
Team workspaces with roles and a shared credit pool

home.title: AI video team for anyone with a story to tell
home.descriptionSignup: Drop in the clips you already shot and say what the video is for. An AI video team cuts and reviews it. Start free, no card required.
home.descriptionContact: Drop in the clips you already shot and say what the video is for. An AI video team cuts and reviews it before you see it, and you can change anything.

pricing.title: Pricing: plans, credits and what is free
pricing.description: Monthly plans with included credits, an estimate before every run, refunds when we fail, and credit packs on paid plans. Cancel anytime. Prices exclude tax.

examples.title: Example: watch the ReelBolt launch film
examples.description: Watch the ReelBolt launch film before you sign up. It shows the product at work, from a request to an AI assistant through to the timeline and picture editor.

about.title: About: why we built an AI video team
about.description: Why ReelBolt exists: so anyone with a story to tell gets a finished video from their own footage and words, with control over models and data.

openSource.title: Open source: read it, run it, or let us host it
openSource.description: ReelBolt is open source under AGPL-3.0. Run it yourself for free, or let us host it. See what each path gives you, how to start, and how the licence works.

contact.title: Contact the ReelBolt team
contact.description: Questions about ReelBolt, a plan for your team or self-hosting? Send us a note about what you want to make and the team will get back to you with an answer.

thanks.title: Thanks
thanks.description: Your message has been received. We will follow up shortly about the video you want to make.

runner.title: Desktop runner
runner.descriptionAvailable: Download the ReelBolt runner to render on a computer you own. Rendering on your own computer uses no credits.
runner.descriptionSoon: The ReelBolt runner, which renders on a computer you own, is still being built. There is nothing to download yet.

features.title: Features: editing, graphics, voice and b-roll
features.description: Auto editing, a timeline and picture editor, designed graphics, brand kit, narration and dubs, generated b-roll, editing rooms, Claude Code and file sync.
